# Security policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/G-aUr-aV/ToDo/security/advisories/new). Use public issues for ordinary bugs and feature requests.

Include the affected commit or version, the affected component, the security impact, and observations from a temporary workspace. Use invented tasks and redact any private information. Keep your live SQLite database, account state, backups, session cookies, and MCP tokens private.

Security fixes target the current default branch. Self-hosted installations receive fixes when their operator updates the running app.
